Thanks — adding a bit more technical color before Wed.

Short load-test plan (for discussion in the session):
- Stage 1 (smoke): 5–10 concurrent sessions, 50–100 requests, short prompts to validate routing and auth.
- Stage 2 (ramp): step to 30 concurrent over 10m, validate batching behaviour and KV cache hit rates.
- Stage 3 (peak): 75 concurrent sustained for 20m, include token-heavy prompts (~1k tokens) to exercise memory and throughput.

Rate-limit/profile suggestions:
- Hosted trial: conservative defaults (requests/sec per token) + prefix caching enabled. Recommend starting with 120 rps token-equivalent and a soft rate limit bump during stage 3.
- Dedicated: allow higher baseline (x2) and we can open larger batch windows to optimize cost. Dedicated will need a reservation and a short quota increase request (we can process internally once contract/intention is clear).

Token budgeting: based on your 45M token target — if you do two peak tests (75 concurrent for 20m) we estimate ~6–8M tokens consumed by the peak windows alone (depends on prompt mixes). We'll prepare a spreadsheet with per-test estimates and upload it to the drive.

Attachment: capacity-estimates.xlsx (stub) — includes per-stage token math and recommended rate limits.

Look forward to the session.
Dev

Redwood Inference
